function_v0.doc:
Reconcile a leader order the KEEPER resolved out-of-band (execution or
cancellation happen via the keeper's execute_order, not a factory call,
so the factory never saw the settlement). Permissionless and idempotent
\xe2\x80\x94 the ownership map is dropped on success, so a second call \xe2\x86\x92 #16.
- Executed \xe2\x86\x92 bind the resulting position to the vault (no cash moved:
the collateral was debited at placement and now lives as equity).
- Cancelled/Slippage/Expired \xe2\x86\x92 credit order.collateral (the market's
refund landed at the factory address) back to the vault's liquid.
- Pending \xe2\x86\x92 #3 (nothing to reconcile yet).
function_v0.name: reconcile_order

function_v0.doc:
Leader pulls accumulated profit share above HWM. Returns the
USDC paid out (zero if NAV \xe2\x89\xa4 HWM).

Formula: ((NAV - HWM) \xc3\x97 circulating_shares \xc3\xb7 PRECISION) \xc3\x97 bps \xc3\xb7 10_000.
On success, total_usdc decreases by the payout and the new HWM
is set to the post-payout NAV \xe2\x80\x94 the leader can't double-claim
the same gain.
function_v0.name: claim_leader_fees

function_v0.doc: The vault that owns a position (None if not a factory position).
function_v0.name: get_position_vault

function_v0.doc:
L1-30: reconcile a vault position the KEEPER closed out-of-band (a
protective SL/TP/trailing fire, or a liquidation) \xe2\x80\x94 proceeds landed at
the factory with no factory call. Permissionless + idempotent (the
PositionVault map is dropped, so a second call \xe2\x86\x92 #16). Credits the EXACT
recorded proceeds (market.get_closed_proceeds), never a global-surplus
guess. While the stale position lingers, full_nav fail-closes (#18), so
the keeper reconciles promptly to unfreeze the vault.
function_v0.name: reconcile_position

accounting always matches truth.

cases.doc: Open would exceed the per-asset-side OI cap or the aggregate\npayout-reservation cap (both sized against vault AUM)
cases.name: OpenInterestCapExceeded

cases.doc: A partial liquidation ran recently: this position is inside its\ngrace period and cannot be liquidated again yet (bankruptcy\noverrides the grace period)
cases.name: LiquidationCooldown

cases.doc: adl_close called while ADL is not active for the position's asset\n(L0-1; check_adl_trigger or a shortfall settle flips the flag)
cases.name: AdlNotActive

cases.doc: adl_close target is not a net winner at the current mark \xe2\x80\x94 only\npositive-uPnL positions are ADL candidates (L0-1)
cases.name: AdlNotEligible

cases.doc: Liquidation eligible on the fresh spot but NOT yet confirmed by the\nsmoothed (TWAP) mark (L0-9). Bankruptcy overrides \xe2\x80\x94 a genuinely\nunderwater position never waits. Retry next keeper cycle.
cases.name: LiquidationNotConfirmed

cases.doc: A market open/close filled worse than the trader's acceptable_price\nbound (L0-10). The tx reverts; resubmit with 0 to fill unbounded.
cases.name: AcceptablePriceExceeded

cases.doc: A risk-increasing op (open / limit / stop-limit placement) hit an\nasset with no per-market risk params configured \xe2\x80\x94 fail-closed\n(L0-12). Risk-reducing paths fall back to the legacy MM instead.
cases.name: AssetRiskNotConfigured

cases.doc: An open would push the asset's net long-short skew past its cap and\nmake it MORE imbalanced (L0-14). Skew-reducing opens always pass.
cases.name: SkewCapExceeded

cases.doc:
Full-freeze pause (mode 2): even risk-reducing ops \xe2\x80\x94 closes,
liquidations, cross deposits/withdrawals, stops, funding \xe2\x80\x94 are halted
symmetrically (L0-15). Only cancel_order works; auto-degrades to
halt-open (closes/liquidations allowed) after 72h.
cases.name: Frozen

cases.doc:
An open auto-nets to zero or beyond against the trader's opposite
same-asset positions \xe2\x80\x94 gross opposite >= requested size, too many
opposing legs, or a sub-min remainder (L1-3). Reductions and flips
go through the close/reduce-only paths, never a one-tx flip.
cases.name: NetsToZero

cases.doc: Trading in this specific market is temporarily halted by admin (L1-24).\nRisk-increasing paths only \xe2\x80\x94 closing/liquidating a position still works.
cases.name: AssetHalted

cases.doc: LP withdrawal is inside the post-deposit cooldown window (L1-28) \xe2\x80\x94 an\nanti-JIT/NAV-sniping delay after each deposit. Everything else is instant.
cases.name: WithdrawCooldownActive
